question: What exact title serialization contract governs the observed NiTexturingProperty slots and their TexDesc, bump, parallax, and shader descriptor payloads?

idAssignment.result: RVA-F-0130 is the canonical identifier for this manifest.

dependencies.use: Accepts RVA-F-0124's validated NiTriShape.Properties -> NiTexturingProperty relationship, exact count-nine observation, aggregate Base/Glow/Shader presence counts, complete block consumption, and privacy boundary without reopening retail payloads.

scope.boundary: The packet inspects the exact NiTexturingProperty reader and writer plus the four directly selected descriptor reader/writer pairs. The pinned schema corroborates standard field names and profile conditions. No retail NIF is reopened, no unrelated property payload is decoded, and no shader, UV, filter, wrap, or renderer semantics are inferred.

typeIdentity.qualification: The title string, initializer, descriptor getter at 0x82357D50, and anchored method table establish the exact type and methods. The pinned schema supplies the standard inheritance name NiTexturingProperty -> NiProperty -> NiObjectNET -> NiObject.

reader.result: Consumes the inherited payload first, then Flags, Texture Count, the ordered standard slot records selected by that count, Num Shader Textures, and the ordered shader records.

writer.result: Emits the inherited payload first, then the same Flags, count, ordered presence-record sequence, shader count, and shader presence-record sequence.

streamContract.blockBoundary: The derived payload begins immediately after the complete variable-width inherited NiObjectNET payload. Its width is count- and presence-dependent and therefore has no one fixed derived byte extent. RVA-F-0124 independently proves exact block consumption for every accepted profile block.
streamContract.serializedAlignment: All fields are packed in the listed order. No title transfer or pinned-schema declaration introduces serialized alignment padding between them.

profileFields: Extra Data count and reference array
inheritedPayload.derivedBoundary: NiProperty adds no serialized field at 20.3.0.9. The exact title reader and writer call their inherited methods before touching NiTexturingProperty-owned Flags at runtime +0x18.
inheritedPayload.qualification: Inherited field identities and profile conditions are accepted from RVA-F-0124 and the pinned schema; this packet does not reinterpret inherited data.

derivedProfileLayout.standardSlots: Texture Count ordered records. Each record begins with one presence byte and contains its descriptor payload only when present.

suffix.serializedType: Num Shader Textures ordered ShaderTexDesc records

derivedProfileLayout.flagsReadPolicy: At the accepted profile, reader 0x82355CC0 reads the two serialized bytes and then retains only bits selected by 0xF00F in the ordinary title object. Writer 0x823563B0 emits that runtime u16. The packet assigns no meaning to any bit.
derivedProfileLayout.countPolicy: The title transfers each count as four bytes, passes it through its container-handling path, and emits one ordered record per retained count. This packet does not promote a title-side count validator or count maximum and does not authorize allocation before block-local bounds prove the complete sequence.

observedPresentDescriptors.result: RVA-F-0124 reported only these present descriptor classes in the accepted observation set. Every accepted standard property had Texture Count equal to nine; Shader records are the separate suffix array rather than a tenth standard slot.

slotContract.absentBehavior: The title still consumes one presence byte for every standard slot selected by Texture Count and for every ShaderTexDesc array element. An absent record consumes no descriptor body and leaves the source order of later presence bytes unchanged.
slotContract.qualification: The exact title labels and pinned profile order support these neutral slot names. They do not establish sampling, UV-set, filtering, wrapping, blending, or shader behavior.

fields.condition: Has Texture Transform equals one in the exact title reader

transformFields: Translation: two consecutive f32 values, 8 bytes
Scale: two consecutive f32 values, 8 bytes
Transform Method: one u32 enum value, 4 bytes
Center: two consecutive f32 values, 8 bytes
TexDesc.sourceBehavior: The reader consumes the four-byte block reference before Flags and resolves it through the title reference path. The writer emits the corresponding reference before Flags. No source reference arithmetic or slot-dependent rewrite occurs in these methods.

extraFields: Bump Matrix: four consecutive f32 values, 16 bytes
BumpTexDesc.result: The exact reader and writer call the TexDesc pair first and then mirror six consecutive four-byte transfers.

ParallaxTexDesc.result: The exact reader and writer call the TexDesc pair first and then mirror one four-byte transfer.

ShaderTexDesc.titleRetention: Reader 0x82356E90 consumes Map ID into a transient local after TexDesc and does not store it in the allocated title descriptor. Writer 0x82356EF8 emits zero after TexDesc. The serialized field and width are exact, but ordinary title runtime state is not a lossless carrier for Map ID.

presenceAndConditionRules.standardSlots: For the accepted count-nine profile, all nine presence bytes occur in fixed source order. A descriptor body follows only a present byte.
presenceAndConditionRules.descriptorTransform: Has Texture Transform controls only the 32-byte transform tail. The title reader takes that tail only when the byte equals one; the writer emits zero or one from the retained transform pointer.
presenceAndConditionRules.shaderRecords: Num Shader Textures controls the number of ShaderTexDesc records. Each begins with Has Map, and the TexDesc plus Map ID body is conditional on that record being present.
presenceAndConditionRules.bumpAndParallax: The Bump and Parallax extra fields are unconditional once their containing standard slot is present. No additional presence byte occurs inside either extension.
presenceAndConditionRules.profileOnly: Count-gated Decal 1 through Decal 3 fields are not serialized when Texture Count is nine. This packet neither promotes nor rejects other texture-count profiles.

rawValueBehavior.preserved: TexDesc source references, TexDesc Flags, transform f32/u32 values, Bump extra f32 values, and Parallax Offset are transferred in source order without arithmetic by their exact reader/writer pairs.
rawValueBehavior.transformed: NiTexturingProperty Flags are masked to 0xF00F after reading, presence values are represented by nullable title objects and emitted as zero or one, and Shader Map ID is discarded on read and emitted as zero. These title-runtime transformations must not be described as raw-value preservation.
rawValueBehavior.retentionPolicy: A bounded read-only Studio parser may retain the original serialized u16 Flags, raw presence bytes, and Shader Map ID in addition to the fields the title retains, because their exact widths, positions, and conditions are proved. It must not use the title's masked or regenerated values as a claim about source bytes.
rawValueBehavior.unresolved: No finite-value, enum-range, bit-validity, UV-set, filter, wrap, transform-effect, or shader-use policy is proved.

implementationContract.supported: Studio may parse and retain the exact count-nine NiTexturingProperty sequence, ordered slot presence values, present descriptor bodies, source block references, raw map flags, optional transform records, bump and parallax extensions, shader count, shader presence values, and raw Map ID values under the neutral labels in this packet.
implementationContract.requiredBoundary: Parsing remains block-bounded and read-only. Counts must be proved against the remaining block extent before reserve or allocation; every reference must remain a raw validated block index until its exact target type is checked; absent bodies consume no bytes; exact block consumption remains mandatory.
implementationContract.excluded: Texture loading, path resolution, sampling, UV selection, filtering, wrapping, color-space policy, shader execution, material interaction, rendering, editing, conversion, export, and writing remain outside this contract.

currentEvidence.method: Every canonical-image query was foreground and read-only after an explicit idle check. Exact Ghidra instructions and bounded decompilation establish title methods; narrow generated-code bodies corroborate truncated functions; the pinned schema corroborates standard field names and profile conditions. No retail NIF payload was opened.

entries.result: The title string, descriptor initializer, descriptor getter, and method table bind NiTexturingProperty to reader 0x82355CC0, writer 0x823563B0, and presentation method 0x82357320.

The inherited call is followed by u16 Flags, u32 Texture Count, ordered one-byte presence records and conditional descriptors, u32 shader count, and ordered shader records; the writer mirrors that sequence.
The exact descriptor pairs establish Source/Flags/optional-transform ordering, the six-f32 bump tail, the one-f32 parallax tail, and the Shader Map ID transfer behavior.

entries.role: observed slot set and full consumption
entries.result: The accepted privacy-preserving aggregate supplies count nine, present Base/Glow/Shader totals 275/24/84, 383 valid NiSourceTexture source edges, and exact block consumption.

currentEvidence.privacy: No retail filename, material value, texture name, identifier, hash, payload, byte sample, or per-file fact was read, retained, or written. Only title executable metadata, pinned schema declarations, and accepted aggregate facts were used.

boundedNegatives: No title consumer in this packet proves filter, wrap, UV-set, coordinate-set, transform-effect, bump, parallax, shader-map, or renderer semantics.
No finite-value, enum-range, map-flag-validity, or presence-byte-validity policy is promoted.
The ordinary title object does not losslessly retain NiTexturingProperty Flags, raw presence bytes, or Shader Map ID; those transformations are recorded explicitly.
Only Texture Count nine is supported by the accepted observation set. Other count profiles and Decal 1 through Decal 3 remain outside this packet.
NiSourceTexture fields, embedded pixel data, runtime resource lookup, shaders, materials, animation, and skinning are not investigated here.

catalogPromotion.result: No canonical catalog entity is added; the title-private field contract is fully represented in this manifest.

guards: Treat RVA-F-0130 as this packet's canonical ID; do not reuse or renumber it without repository-wide reconciliation.
Do not interpret raw Flags, Map ID, transform enum, presence bytes, or slot names as renderer behavior.
Do not claim title-runtime losslessness for masked Flags, regenerated presence bytes, or discarded Shader Map ID.
Do not allocate from Texture Count or Num Shader Textures before the complete block-local byte requirement is proved.
Do not extend this packet into Studio implementation, texture loading, rendering, editing, conversion, export, or writing.
conclusion: NiTexturingProperty's exact title reader 0x82355CC0 and writer 0x823563B0 consume the inherited payload first, then a packed variable-width sequence of u16 Flags, u32 Texture Count, ordered standard slot presence records, u32 shader count, and ordered ShaderTexDesc records. At the accepted count-nine profile, the standard slot order is Base, Dark, Detail, Gloss, Glow, Bump, Normal, Parallax, and Decal 0; the bounded observation set found only Base, Glow, and separate Shader descriptors present. Exact descriptor pairs establish Source, raw map Flags, optional 32-byte transform, bump and parallax tails, and Shader Map ID. Read-only serialized-field retention is implementation-ready within the stated bounds, while sampling, UV, filter, wrap, shader, material, and renderer semantics remain unresolved.
